file_purpose: Research and implementation mapping for University of Buckingham MB ChB Medicine 71A8 January 2027 entry.

implemented: IB academic eligibility using the current course-linked PDF and UCAS value
graduate same-course academic eligibility by degree classification
excluded: Scottish S5 plus Advanced Higher automation
conditional GCSE science automation for applicants taking only one A-level science

applicant_pool.notes: Official sources confirm Home/UK and International fee rows and UCAS international applicant information. No separate academic or progression threshold by fee status is published.

contextual_policy.notes: No Buckingham 71A8 contextual reduction or guaranteed-interview route was identified in the official sources reviewed.

limitations: Buckingham publishes a staged process but not a numeric MMA score, MMI score or progression threshold.
No historical interview invitation cut-offs or progression rates were found.
The course page body and official PDF/UCAS disagree on IB total points; ApplySmart uses the 34-point PDF/UCAS value and records the discrepancy.
Country-specific international qualification rules are official but too broad for the current generic evaluator.

gcse.conditional_science_review: Applicants who have not completed A-level Biology or Chemistry should have studied the missing subject to GCSE/equivalent and achieved grade B. This conditional rule is documented but not auto-executed.

a_level.resits: A-level resits are possible only under published mitigation conditions.

ib.hl: Biology and Chemistry both taken at HL, with at least HL6 in one and HL5 in the other.
ib.discrepancy: Course page body states 32 points while UCAS and the course-linked 2026/27 PDF state 34 points.

scottish.published: S5 AABBB plus two Advanced Highers including Chemistry and one from Biology or Maths at BB.

graduate.degree: Bachelor degree in a subject cognate to Medicine with or predicted at least 2:1.

english_language.ielts: 7.0 overall and minimum 6.5 in each component
english_language.cambridge_english_advanced: 185 overall average and minimum 176 in each paper
english_language.automation_status: IELTS Academic/UKVI automated; Cambridge and exemptions manual review.

implementation_mapping.architecture_change_summary: Generic optional fee_information schema/presenter support and configured IELTS component thresholds were added. No Buckingham-specific frontend hard-coding was introduced.

evidence_gaps.notes: The digital MMA scoring and progression criteria are not published.
No official progression rate from academic screen or MMA to MMI was found.
ApplySmart uses the 34-point requirement from UCAS and the current course-linked entry requirements PDF.
The current generic evaluator cannot conditionally require GCSE Biology or Chemistry only when the applicant lacks that A-level subject.

source_evidence.title: MB ChB Medicine (4.5-year degree)
source_evidence.summary: Verifies January 2027 full-time 4.5-year undergraduate MB ChB, 71A8 UCAS code, ABB including Chemistry or Biology, GCSE English/Maths grade 4, IELTS 7.0/6.5, staged academic screen/MMA/MMI process, Home and International fees, deposit and direct application route.

source_evidence.title: Medicine 2026/27 Entry Requirements
source_evidence.summary: Verifies A-level ABB, General Studies exclusion, A-level resit conditions, Scottish Advanced Higher route, IB 34, UK Science degree 2:1 and country-specific requirements.

source_evidence.title: Medicine, University of Buckingham
source_evidence.summary: Verifies course code 71A8, institution code B90, MB ChB 4.5 years, January start, Year 1 point of entry and UCAS application details.
